Subject: Re: NTL Digital TV quality (was Re: [ILUG] Broadband in Dublin)

FRLinux wrote:
> On 10/10/07, Michael Watterson  wrote:
>   
>> There are clear dishes and disguised  dishes.  You  can  even  point  a
>> dish from indoors through a  window or  have it on the  floor of a
>> balcony with a plastic sheet over it.
>>     
>
> This is all wonderful but it does require line of sight which in my
> case is not possible.
>
> Steph
>   
Complain to your TD.
The DTT situation has been fudged for nearly 8 years. The Government 
needs to bite the bullet and pay for roll out, as they should have done 
in 1999 or 2000. People should not be forced to get Pay TV (20% can't 
receive TV3 and 8% can't receive TG4, most of those in  Irish speaking 
areas).

Line of sight is about 20 degree elevation to  South  East. It should 
have  been closer to 30 deg elevation and slightly west of South. But 
Sky "pinched" Central Europe satellite slot for UK. Our 
Government/Companies sold our original slot to the Norwegians. We are 
almost unique in not having a Satellite service, riding on coat tails of 
the non-British Murdoch system designed for the UK.

Lots of  places even in the main cities don't get cable or even cable at 
good enough quality for broadband and Digital due to neglect of the 
network for 20 years. At least UPC is upgrading it.

-- 
Mike
